description:
Rimuru has officially become a Demon Lord after defeating Clayman. Following Walpurgis, the Demon Lords' banquet, Rimuru's domain is expanded to include the entire Great Forest of Jura. Anticipating a flood of representatives from all races showing up to pay their respects, Rimuru decides to throw a festival to commemorate the opening of Tempest, using it as an opportunity to gain new citizens and present Demon Lord Rimuru to the world. Meanwhile, in the Holy Empire of Lubelius, home base of the monster-hating cult of Luminism, Holy Knight Captain Hinata receives a message from Rimuru. But the message is actually a fabricated declaration of war sent by some unknown party. Upon learning that Hinata is heading for Tempest, Rimuru makes a decision... Thus begins a new challenge for Rimuru, striving to distinguish friend from foe in his pursuit of the ideal nation where humans and monsters can prosper together.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
__Species:__  Human (past life) → Slime
__Kind:__  Reincarnated, Otherworlder

Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

alternative: Greatest Among the Ten Great Demon Lords At Digging Up Sweet Potatoes

node.description:
__Kind:__ Inhabitant

"Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

alternative: Legendary Ogre Goddess At Digging Up Sweet Potatoes

node.description: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

Diablo is the Black Primordial and a loyal servant of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Before he met Rimuru, he went by the nicknames Black or Noir, the latter which he received from his fellow Primordial kin. After receiving the name Diablo from Rimuru, he evolved to a Demon Peer.

name.native: ヴェルドラ＝テンペスト

node.description:
__Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form)
__Species:__ True Dragon
__Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally
__Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe

Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas

Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces.

Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

Shizu was the companion of the previous Hero and a Japanese Summoned One. She is also known as the "Explosive Monarch", an A ranked Adventurer of the Freedom Association's Headquarters, and the formal homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy's S Class students.

She was also the mentor of several excellent pupils whom became important figures of society.

__Height:__ 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre)

Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

"Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

name.native: ルミナス・バレンタイン

node.description: "Queen of Nightmares" Luminous Valentine is an elite vampire and one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords. She is also the true ruler of the Holy Kingdom Ruberion.
Gobta is a hobgoblin and is one of Rimuru Tempest's followers. Though he seems to be air-headed he tends to be a hard-worker and dependable when the time calls for it.

Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. 

~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~

~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~
Ramiris is a fairy that resides inside of Tempest's Underground Labyrinth. She is also one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

Hakurou is a Fair Oni and is a loyal follower of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He was one of the survivors of the Orc attack. He was also the teacher of the Dwarven King.

Hinata Sakaguchi is an otherworlder and the leader of the Imperial Guards under the Pope's direct command. Along with [Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/132755/Kagurazaka-Yuuki) and Class S, she's a former student of [Shizue Izawa](https://anilist.co/character/128037/Shizu).

~!At first she thought monsters should all be exterminated. But after her fight with Rimuru, she was convinced that Rimuru is not evil.!~
Guy Crimson is the oldest of the Demon Lords. He has forever ruled over the frozen continent. Being androgynous, he can become a man or woman at will.
One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Chloe is a quiet child who loves books.
Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

Albis, known as the Golden Serpent, is one of Carrion's Beastman subordinates. She is the leader of Yuurazania's Three Beastketeers.

~!She becomes one of Benimaru's wives later on along with Momiji!~
The captain of the Hiryuu of Tempest, and the former lizardmen raid leader. He suffers from a superiority complex. The root of Gabil's pride and confidence​ is the thought that he is the chosen one.

"Sky Queen" Frey is an ex-Demon Lord and currently a subordinate of [Demon Lord Milim Nava](https://anilist.co/character/128036/Nava-Milim). She often scolds Milim for playing around when she is supposed to be working.

Formerly the chief of the goblin village [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru) comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.
Gabil's younger sister, and the daughter of Abil. After the Orc Lord incident, she swears her allegeiance to Rimuru. She attends to Souei as a spy.
Suphia, known as the White Tiger Claw, is one of Beast Kingdom Eurazania's Three Beastketeers. She is described as having a ferocious aura that has been likened to a "battle-hardened leader".

He is one of the fourth group of subordinates to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). As the right-hand man of the deceased Orc Lord, he was given the same name as him, as a memento and token of appreciation, similar to how [Rigur](https://anilist.co/character/129349/Rigur) was named after his older brother.

As an Orc King, he is the leader of the Yellow Corps, that acts as both the last line of defense for Tempest as well as the main team of the country's Department of Construction and Manufacturing. Later on, he was given the Title of a "Lord" as one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons.

Eren is an adventurer and a member of Kaval's Party. ~!She is actually the daughter of the Duke of Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion Elalude, who ran off to be an adventurer due to her selfishness and free-spirited personality.!~
 
(Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

A travelling wizard who was granted a place in Youm's party as their advisor after defeating the aforementioned in a duel.

~!Of Clayman's "Five Fingers", she was the "Ring Finger", acting as one of his spies until Rimuru severs his control over her heart.!~
One of the children who were incompletely summoned. At 9 years old, Alice is the youngest of the group, and she's also a bit of a tomboy.

Kaijin was a blacksmith of the Dwarven Kingdom, and the brother of Kaidou. After he was exiled from his own country, he became Rimuru Tempest's subordinate, and helped build the Monster City "Tempest", he acted as a builder, blacksmith, and craftsmen. He also was the former commander of the Dwargon Engineering Corps.

node.description: Leon Cromwell is a former hero and a current Demon Lord of the Eight-pointed Star Octagram. He is the ruler of El Dorado, an island nation located south-west of the world.

Rigur was named after his late elder brother.

Rigur, after making [Gobta](https://anilist.co/character/129350/Gobta) the garrison squad leader, has been supporting his father [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348/Rigurd).
~!Karion is one of the ten demon lords that existed before Rimuru became a demon lord. During the Walpurgis Banquet where Rimuru killed Clayman. Karion became a subordinate of Milim.!~
Demon Lord Deeno, known as the Sleeping Ruler, is one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

name.native: ヨウム・ファルメナス

node.description: The Hero-King Farmenas of the Farmenas Kingdom. Formerly the Farmas Kingdom, Count Nidole Maigam’s Territory's, Frontier Garrison Captain Youm.
She is a resident of the goblin village.

A former student of [Shizu](https://anilist.co/character/128037/Shizu) who originally came from Japan and ~!one of the main antagonists of the series.!~ Yuuki serves as the Guild Master of the Adventurers' Guild in the kingdom of Ingracia, and he loves manga.

~!Although Yuuki first comes as a friendly person he is actually a master in manipulating others without hesitation to achieve his goal of a just world that treats everyone fairly. Even though Rimuru and Yuuki get along at first he later addresses Rimuru as a very serious threat to his plans.!~
He is the vice-president of the Moderate Jesters and as that a loyal subordinate of Demon Lord Kazaream.

Momiji is the child of Hakurou and Kaede. She's been entrusted in Hakurou's care by her mother in the hopes that she progresses in her training and improve her skills, and above all, to form a bond with her father. She's currently staying in Tempest.

(Source: That  Time I got Reincarnated as a Slime fandom)

Species: Dwarf
Blessing / Divine Protection: Divine Protector of Ancestor
Title: King of Armament Nation Dwargon.
The king of Dwargon, Gazel Dwargo, the third generation king of Dwargon, but possesses a similar aura to that of his grandfather in his younger days. He is renowned as a great hero and celebrated as a wise king for his impartial rule.

name.native: エルメシア・エルリュ・サリオン

node.description: The Emperor of Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion and a High Elf. She's well acquainted with both Gazel Dwargo and Leon Cromwell. She's also the cousin of Eren. She and Rimuru, along with their respective nations, are in a treaty with each other.

Beretta is a Greater Demon that was summoned by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru) to protect [Ramiris](https://anilist.co/character/131034/Ramiris) to make up for destroying her previous golem. They incarnated in a golem made out of pure magisteel and have served her since.
One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Ryouta has a shy personality, but he generally gets along well with [Kenya](https://anilist.co/character/132751/Misaki-Kenya).

One of the ninth group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. She was originally a small fox spirit enslaved by Clayman and was freed from his curse by Rimuru. 

(Source: The Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime wiki)
A survivor of the Ogre Village. He is given his name by  [Towa](https://anilist.co/character/285168), the queen of the kingdom of Raja.

Myrd is younger brother of Garm and Dord. Though he was a dwarf of few words, he was an expert at what he does. Having knowledge in construction, and well-versed in the arts, he is a one of a kind genius. Myrd was appointed as the captain of the construction team.
Grucius is a Beastman from the Beast Kingdom Eurazania.

The granddaughter of [Granbell Rosso](https://anilist.co/character/326217/Rosso-Granbell).

~!An Otherworlder who died and got reincarnated here as a new person carrying her memory of the previous world; responsible for manipulating the Seven Celestial Sages behind the scenes.!~

Member of the Moderate Jesters alongside [Laplace](https://anilist.co/character/134593/Laplace) and [Footman](https://anilist.co/character/198040/Footman), and as that loyal subordinate of Demon Lord Kazaream.

The green Demon Primordial and a subordinate of fellow Primordial [Guy Crimson](https://anilist.co/character/131048/Guy-Crimson). Guy is the one who gave Mizeri her name. Mizeri's partner is the Blue Primordial [Raine](https://anilist.co/character/198042/Raine).
A member of a group of children who were incompletely summoned. He is the leader of the pack and has a lively disposition.
Adalman, formerly the Index Finger of Clayman's Five Fingers, is an Undead and the guardian of the 70th floor of Ramiris' Labyrinth.

name.native: ガルド・ミョルマイル

node.description: An influential merchant from the kingdom of Burumund. Myorumairu is both the chairman of the Burumund shopping district and also a loan shark.

Kagali is an elf that serves as secretary to [Yuuki Kagurazaka](https://anilist.co/character/132755/Kagurazaka-Yuuki).

~!Her true identity is that of a former Demon Lord, and president of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance, who had once been known as Curse Lord Kazaream. Seemingly killed by [Leon Cromwell](https://anilist.co/character/131047/Cromwell-Leon) 200 years ago, Kazaream managed to survive by escaping with just his Astral Body and now occupies a Homunculus body in the shape of a female elf.!~

Kurobee is a Fair Oni and a loyal follower of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Kurobee was originally one of the Oni that survived the Orc attack. He evolved after being named by Rimuru.
Tiss is a homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy.

Bester (ベスター Besutā) is a former minister of Dwargon and is currently the lead researcher of Tempest.
~!After joining Tempest he has become more reliable. He got rid of that sharp personality and mellowed out.!~
One of the children who were incompletely summoned. At 11 years old, he is the eldest of the group.

Gido is a member of Cabal's Party who serves as the 'thief' role. ~!However, he is actually serving as one of the bodyguards of Lady Elyune secretly while under the guise of an adventurer.!~

(Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

Kaval is the leader of his adventure's party, where he serves as the 'fighter' role. ~!Alongside Gido, he is also tasked as the secret bodyguard of Lady Elyune under the guise of an adventurer.!~

(Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

node.description: The former king of the Kingdom of Falmuth.

Reyhiem, an archbishop of the Western Holy Church, was the most powerful religious figure in the Kingdom of Falmuth. He was (on paper, at least) on equal footing with the king himself given Falmuth's adoption of Luminism as its state religion. That was just a formality, however; in reality, Reyhiem was more of a trusted right-hand man, taking his cues from the king.
